steps.title: tiling: its views
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved tiling

steps.title: tiling: A scrolling tiling window manager: new terminals and browsers split into their own panes, side by side panes scroll sideways instead of shrinking, columns keep no extra rows, focus follows the mouse, links open in a new column, and a thin rail sidebar (point at it) with numbered workspaces and a status bar at the bottom.
